title: Chromium crashes mid-test in Docker with 'Target page, context or browser has been closed'
symptoms: page.goto: Target page, context or browser has been closed
Crashes appear on heavy pages or with several workers, never on a laptop
cause: Docker gives containers a 64 MB /dev/shm by default, and Chromium uses shared memory for rendering. Without --ipc=host it runs out and the renderer dies.
fix: Run the container with --ipc=host and --init, or raise shm size on platforms that do not allow host IPC.
apply:
docker run --rm --init --ipc=host mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.0-noble npx playwright test
# compose: ipc: host   or   shm_size: 2gb
affected: All Playwright versions running Chromium in Docker or Kubernetes
